verdict.rationale: A desktop app exists: `codex app` gives the desktop experience, and community posts reference the native Codex App release, though users report it is Mac-only and had launch-time loading issues. Visual diff inspection and parallel tasks are documented only for Codex cloud and web, not specifically inside the desktop app. Missing for 10: first-party docs showing visual diff review and side-by-side multi-session work in the desktop app itself, cross-platform (Linux/Windows) availability, and hands-on corroboration of those desktop features.
